verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gate overrides that let specific users bypass a gate, and its first-feature tutorial walks through targeting internal testers on a gate. Together these cover the core of per-user allowlisting and beta-tester targeting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of excluding specific individual users (blocklist or deny overrides), detail on how overrides are configured (user IDs, emails, segments), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
